Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 24, "heading": "CHAPTER 22. SOME OLD SCENES, AND SOME NEW PEOPLE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u024-b0030", "target": "— Бог весть, — сказал Стирфорт. — Побродив до парома в поисках тебя, я зашёл сюда и нашёл дом пустым. Это навело меня на размышления, и ты застал меня за ними.", "source_sha256": "7e671b55ddefa511f1ce87a03e16615659d46872d10345369bd8fd97c76af33b", "target_id": "ru-en85-u024-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7475c3add9e8e81bf6050be957486ed22e80fb6d15a561dab53d80be88d9c826"}, {"source_id": "en85-u024-b0031", "target": "Появление миссис Гаммидж с корзиной объяснило, почему дом оказался пуст. Она выбежала купить что-то нужное к возвращению мистера Пегготи с приливом и оставила дверь открытой, чтобы Хэм и малютка Эмли, у которых в тот день был ранний вечер, не остались на пороге, если вернутся, пока её нет. Стирфорт, изрядно подбодрив миссис Гаммидж весёлым приветствием и шутливым объятием, взял меня под руку и поспешно увёл.", "source_sha256": "1d6430436c92388cc775b9a5d302089c2497aa5dff908acedf42c136ad81d292", "target_id": "ru-en85-u024-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "17df6c4fd5417db7d1bf5ffe95a4ce73a614d1f8c596c33007bda387ede5114e"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 22, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u024-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He had improved his own spirits, no less than Mrs. Gummidge’s, for they were again at their usual flow, and he was full of vivacious conversation as we went along.", "sha256": "f9e89c723400fd65d7c04f97526c7d37044bf88e39261d7c1f0391960229500a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[32]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And so,’ he said, gaily, ‘we abandon this buccaneer life tomorrow, do we?’", "sha256": "cc83d30f0a2db1a1a72e34fab4e89de592d16655f573e797aaf1036746eb503d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘So we agreed,’ I returned. ‘And our places by the coach are taken, you know.’", "sha256": "d1c15e328f998703cc93e3fa1229e8570fa50aa173b8f230a39f22b3108b4453", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ay! there’s no help for it, I suppose,’ said Steerforth. ‘I have almost forgotten that there is anything to do in the world but to go out tossing on the sea here. I wish there was not.’", "sha256": "9d113b5f11d232d1bc646e91a85e3e655e0722f5a34920de4b3008b02cdb69e0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘As long as the novelty should last,’ said I, laughing.", "sha256": "4fab379d400135c29f7438df9ff1c5b17c077db3f451e89c0e624a30f3723cf4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Like enough,’ he returned; ‘though there’s a sarcastic meaning in that observation for an amiable piece of innocence like my young friend. Well! I dare say I am a capricious fellow, David. I know I am; but while the iron is hot, I can strike it vigorously too. I could pass a reasonably good examination already, as a pilot in these waters, I think.’", "sha256": "52bd2bc4fe9da89c960d30a939ec653b40c70a97a202bde615b760a2fb7a49e4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Mr. Peggotty says you are a wonder,’ I returned.", "sha256": "ea26b1deab529f99ce271cfe143f372a97d9229dffe6e7934e49234a259d75aa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A nautical phenomenon, eh?’ laughed Steerforth.", "sha256": "471a293a0d2303c530b6e0d6855e958ee03c79019c5d900f40d2d094f07ae687", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Indeed he does, and you know how truly; I know how ardent you are in any pursuit you follow, and how easily you can master it. And that amazes me most in you, Steerforth—that you should be contented with such fitful uses of your powers.’", "sha256": "1d43fc206833127bd7389cc2349c971adeb4f041e6ae7a5e8d3333e623593a3a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Contented?’ he answered, merrily. ‘I am never contented, except with your freshness, my gentle Daisy. As to fitfulness, I have never learnt the art of binding myself to any of the wheels on which the Ixions of these days are turning round and round. I missed it somehow in a bad apprenticeship, and now don’t care about it.—-You know I have bought a boat down here?’", "sha256": "804bd72f1fe044b0149ddc56822cb6986d8df5b1954931dcc1990a2629e5fd59", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What an extraordinary fellow you are, Steerforth!’ I exclaimed, stopping—for this was the first I had heard of it. ‘When you may never care to come near the place again!’", "sha256": "1ef336019e2c58403a6c9583e8c8d40f6f695bf40c2806e183eced87d38a7960", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t know that,’ he returned. ‘I have taken a fancy to the place. At all events,’ walking me briskly on, ‘I have bought a boat that was for sale—a clipper, Mr. Peggotty says; and so she is—and Mr. Peggotty will be master of her in my absence.’", "sha256": "4593723085d3afe3ed6fa6a8d7e833904b9469aed82767d830d390a6eae9f1a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now I understand you, Steerforth!’ said I, exultingly. ‘You pretend to have bought it for yourself, but you have really done so to confer a benefit on him. I might have known as much at first, knowing you. My dear kind Steerforth, how can I tell you what I think of your generosity?’", "sha256": "8849801bac0631d53a3a8aafaad0332509835829e7558c8ffcad4c3b0f477b35", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Tush!’ he answered, turning red. ‘The less said, the better.’", "sha256": "b59bbea523ec6a037ea1dd2f96e701c3afc0a1681725bfe327120f59d251009a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Didn’t I know?’ cried I, ‘didn’t I say that there was not a joy, or sorrow, or any emotion of such honest hearts that was indifferent to you?’", "sha256": "3c8f34748b49ceb0a3179def0b92cd4ef9fff272063fd5c7ca8e478b6fbff60e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Aye, aye,’ he answered, ‘you told me all that. There let it rest. We have said enough!’", "sha256": "c771bc4ca5b9af7024c478b1b59aa6d2f6087580d4164fed1c54ff129397981a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Afraid of offending him by pursuing the subject when he made so light of it, I only pursued it in my thoughts as we went on at even a quicker pace than before.", "sha256": "19da24f76cf6ec7374f0df887d5eae3eaf69a7a42cb967e28298d91172d7d450", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘She must be newly rigged,’ said Steerforth, ‘and I shall leave Littimer behind to see it done, that I may know she is quite complete. Did I tell you Littimer had come down?’", "sha256": "cfb4b9b7f8cc53ab1802f1406dc8aec0272dae43964edcce60c1cda188d0a7f7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No.’", "sha256": "2bdf78717dff75748376e7bf00029aed95c88e280ab52148149726890e89781e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh yes! came down this morning, with a letter from my mother.’", "sha256": "e1d62d09dcda917751bc92f1baa981727faa41a2d90f6203178507f72ca094b1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As our looks met, I observed that he was pale even to his lips, though he looked very steadily at me. I feared that some difference between him and his mother might have led to his being in the frame of mind in which I had found him at the solitary fireside. I hinted so.", "sha256": "1fa8ac12ebe1524f214cb8b7fdf40a05b3e86bd5b2f92cc1fe4157650ca293f0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh no!’ he said, shaking his head, and giving a slight laugh. ‘Nothing of the sort! Yes. He is come down, that man of mine.’", "sha256": "a6651935977d398b84c089f3a3959b804d183f537a71645824197b7b70a5f9cd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The same as ever?’ said I.", "sha256": "f8336871cc8d032465e56ba52b6fae320bc0248ad94eb290375cddc6df8bbb16", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The same as ever,’ said Steerforth. ‘Distant and quiet as the North Pole. He shall see to the boat being fresh named. She’s the “Stormy Petrel” now. What does Mr. Peggotty care for Stormy Petrels! I’ll have her christened again.’", "sha256": "805984b9d818ebc08d0f6d4202ec4ea4aa17ded538b2999173e7c16209305a07", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘By what name?’ I asked.", "sha256": "5624c30bb04822a94538d192efa56beb6c72dee5d7ce074e703d00c779b0b888", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The “Little Em’ly”.’", "sha256": "7aeedec565c8d7f5ee4a70deed3ae34c5d4dd4be5d73dc36b6242ce4f964e757", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As he had continued to look steadily at me, I took it as a reminder that he objected to being extolled for his consideration. I could not help showing in my face how much it pleased me, but I said little, and he resumed his usual smile, and seemed relieved.", "sha256": "3b63004be9485e88500c74d4d077da04c686edfdab7da9dee45f33afc7753e11", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But see here,’ he said, looking before us, ‘where the original little Em’ly comes! And that fellow with her, eh? Upon my soul, he’s a true knight. He never leaves her!’", "sha256": "6b81aa4b2438073747a70dbde109671d15248bb264249909bc2ed631e7c5c5ad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Ham was a boat-builder in these days, having improved a natural ingenuity in that handicraft, until he had become a skilled workman. He was in his working-dress, and looked rugged enough, but manly withal, and a very fit protector for the blooming little creature at his side. Indeed, there was a frankness in his face, an honesty, and an undisguised show of his pride in her, and his love for her, which were, to me, the best of good looks. I thought, as they came towards us, that they were well matched even in that particular.", "sha256": "01dbd9c66651ee4bd8f8f2192139b004e9f202c2505db4c898c53dc616991c8f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "She withdrew her hand timidly from his arm as we stopped to speak to them, and blushed as she gave it to Steerforth and to me. When they passed on, after we had exchanged a few words, she did not like to replace that hand, but, still appearing timid and constrained, walked by herself. I thought all this very pretty and engaging, and Steerforth seemed to think so too, as we looked after them fading away in the light of a young moon.", "sha256": "d94c048d5229411d58d4ab81a1d45588920d5a2bc249cf9455a25b591d643d0f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Suddenly there passed us—evidently following them—a young woman whose approach we had not observed, but whose face I saw as she went by, and thought I had a faint remembrance of. She was lightly dressed; looked bold, and haggard, and flaunting, and poor; but seemed, for the time, to have given all that to the wind which was blowing, and to have nothing in her mind but going after them. As the dark distant level, absorbing their figures into itself, left but itself visible between us and the sea and clouds, her figure disappeared in like manner, still no nearer to them than before.", "sha256": "3e97b292a1d5f5dbc65e833c275d40309d8c64e6fe0c518a4b2cb79f2a528b9c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u024-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That is a black shadow to be following the girl,’ said Steerforth, standing still; ‘what does it mean?’", "sha256": "94890ed641a57c74acdb4c827ac1a815c3b1cc2eda1e1c9621b3aad99f6f0dea", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[29]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
